name: claude-automate
description: Plain English to working Claude automations. Maps user intent to Claude's native primitives — hooks, scheduled tasks, skills, agents, MCP servers — and generates tested, production-ready configurations. Grows with Claude: every new capability Claude adds becomes a building block this skill can wire up.

skills.description: Build Claude automations from plain English. Say what you want automated, get working hooks, scheduled tasks, skills, agents, or MCP configs.
